findings.fix: Factor a private lemma `∀ σ τ, (∀ F : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), ∃ σ' τ', (∀ i ∈ F.image Prod.fst, σ' i = σ i) ∧ (∀ j ∈ F.image Prod.snd, τ' j = τ j) ∧ ρ.map (pairReindex σ' τ') = ρ) → ρ.map (pairReindex σ τ) = ρ`, and derive both theorems from it (the joint case instantiates σ' = τ' = the single finitary perm agreeing with σ on `F.image Prod.fst ∪ F.image Prod.snd`).

findings.evidence: `def pairReindex (σ τ) (x) : ℕ × ℕ → α := fun p => x (σ p.1, τ p.2)` at Basic.lean:115-116, so the lemma is `rfl`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem pairReindex_def (σ τ : Equiv.Perm ℕ) : pairReindex (α := α) σ τ = fun x p => x (σ p.1, τ p.2) := rfl` next to `pairReindex_apply` and rewrite with it in all four places.
findings.issue: `hfun : (fun x p => x (σ p.1, τ p.2)) = pairReindex σ τ` is re-proved by `funext` in each proof that needs it: Basic.lean:284, Extreme.lean:128 (new), plus Basic.lean:299 and Ergodic.lean:100.

summary: Two new proofs close an identity-map goal with an undocumented-by-false-comment defeq `show ... = id from rfl` when `Measure.map_id'` — already used twice in these very files — applies directly. The new `separatelyExchangeable_of_finitary` also duplicates the body of `jointlyExchangeable_of_smulInvariantMeasure` almost verbatim instead of sharing the finite-marginal argument.
